1.explanation: These files cover the rendering of categories and individual audit details (where warnings will be injected), the top-level report renderer (to ensure the warnings block is included), and the UI feature flags (in case warnings visibility is toggled). The paired test files validate existing behavior and must be updated to assert that warnings within passed audits are now rendered correctly.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows the Lighthouse report’s “Passed audits” section being expanded, but none of the audit-level warnings (e.g. invalid image sizes, unable to decode images, malformed viewport properties) are visible. The plan is to add an explicit “Warnings” block immediately after the “Passed audits” heading. This block should render as an orange-outlined container with bullet lists of each warning under their respective audits. Key UI elements involved include the category header (“Passed audits”), the expand/collapse toggle, the warnings container (styled box), list items for each warning message, and underlying DOM renderers that build the audit list and details.
